sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.sourceRequired: Select at least one available source.

failure.permission_denied: Capture stopped because audio permission was denied or revoked.
failure.source_unavailable: Capture stopped because the audio source became unavailable. Finalized content was kept.
failure.no_transcriber: No usable transcription provider was available.
failure.storage_error: The session could not be saved locally.
failure.secret_store_unavailable: The system credential store became unavailable.
failure.interrupted: The app closed during capture. Finalized content was kept.
failure.internal: Capture stopped because of an unexpected error.

sessions.pausedHint: Capture paused: nothing is captured or processed until you resume. The interval appears as a gap in the transcript.

unavailable.not_validated_on_platform: Not yet validated on this platform.
unavailable.os_version: Requires a newer operating system version.

consent.title: Before capturing
consent.body: You are responsible for following your organization's policies and for informing participants and obtaining their consent where applicable. Capture only starts after you confirm.

permissionHelp.title: How to grant the permission
permissionHelp.generic: Open the system privacy settings and allow Dev Copilot to use the microphone. Then start the capture again.

macos.microphone: Open System Settings › Privacy & Security › Microphone and turn on Dev Copilot. Then start the capture again.
macos.system: Open System Settings › Privacy & Security and allow system audio recording for Dev Copilot.

windows.microphone: Open Settings › Privacy & security › Microphone, turn on microphone access and allow desktop apps. Then start the capture again.
windows.system: System audio capture on Windows needs no separate permission; check that the output device is active.

linux.microphone: Check your sound settings (PipeWire/PulseAudio) that the microphone is not muted and the app can access it. In sandboxed installs (Flatpak/Snap), grant the microphone permission. Then start the capture again.
linux.system: Check your sound settings (PipeWire/PulseAudio) that a monitor source is available.

providers.title: Providers
providers.help: Local providers process everything on this computer. A remote provider only receives data after you authorize it, and you can revoke the authorization at any time.
providers.name: {{adapter}} ({{model}})
providers.credentialStored: API key kept in the system credential store
providers.revoked: Authorization of {{name}} revoked. No new data will be sent.

form.remoteHint: Remote provider: data leaves this computer only after your authorization. The address must use https.
form.localHint: Local provider: the address must be this computer (127.0.0.1 or localhost).
form.finalsOnly: In remote mode the transcript shows only the final text of each passage, without provisional text.
form.secretReplace: New API key (leave empty to keep the current one)
form.reauthorizeHint: Changing the address or the data sent revokes the current authorization; you will need to authorize again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.analysisLimitsHelp: They control how often incremental analysis runs and what it costs.
settings.triggerSpeechSecs: Or every N seconds of speech

errors.invalidInput: Invalid value. Check the fields and try again.
errors.invalidState: This action is not allowed in the current state.
errors.permissionDenied: The operating system denied capture permission.
errors.noTranscriber: No usable transcription provider is configured.
errors.secretStoreUnavailable: The system credential store is unavailable. Nothing will be saved until it can be accessed.
errors.authorizationRequired: This remote provider needs your authorization before it receives data.
errors.providerError: The provider failed. Try again later.
errors.storageError: Data could not be saved locally.
errors.modelDownloadNetwork: The model could not be downloaded. Check your connection and try again.
errors.modelVerificationFailed: The downloaded file does not match the expected model and was discarded.
errors.modelDownloadStorage: The model could not be written to disk.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.empty: The transcript appears here as soon as someone speaks.
transcript.lag: The transcript is about {{seconds}} s behind the audio.

providerInUse.label: Providers in use
providerInUse.fallback: The remote {{stage}} provider failed; the local provider took over this stage.

models.title: Local transcription models
models.help: Local transcription uses a model downloaded once. The download only starts when you ask for it and sends no session data.

records.title: Technical records
records.empty: Proposals from the analysis show up here as the conversation goes on.

analysis.invalid_output: The analysis reply was not in the expected format and was discarded. Existing records were kept.
analysis.provider_error: The analysis failed. Existing records were kept; the segments will be analysed again next time.
analysis.rate_limited: Analysis limit reached. Capture continues; new segments wait for the next allowed analysis.

detail.active: This session is still in progress; follow it on the Sessions page.

questions.title: Questions about the session
questions.label: Your question
questions.hint: Answers use only this session's content. Ctrl+Enter sends.
questions.waitPending: Wait for the previous answer before asking again.
questions.empty: Ask, for example, what was decided about a topic. Capture continues while the answer is prepared.

status.pending: Waiting for the answer… Capture and transcription continue normally.
status.failed: The question could not be answered. Nothing was changed, and capture and transcription continue normally. Try asking again.

certainty.partial: Partly supported: part of the answer was not discussed

questions.noCitations: No excerpt or record of the session supports an answer.
questions.convertLabel: Turn the answer into an item: {{question}}
questions.converted: Proposed item added to the plan. Review it before confirming.

export.title: Export session
export.unencryptedWarning: Exported files are not encrypted. Anyone with access to them can read the meeting content; keep them somewhere safe.
export.chooseSomething: Choose at least one format and one kind of content.
export.choosingDestination: Choose where to save in the system window…
export.cancelled: Export cancelled; no file was written.

deleteSession.title: Delete “{{title}}”?
deleteSession.stopFirst: This session is still running. Stop capture before deleting it.

warning.secureDeletion: The content is removed from this computer's encrypted database, but secure removal is not guaranteed: SSDs, snapshots and the file system may keep copies of old data.
warning.backups: System backups made before the deletion still contain this session.
warning.exportedFiles: Files already exported are not deleted; remove them yourself if needed.

authorization.title: Authorize sending data to {{destination}}?
authorization.nothingSent: Nothing is sent before you accept. If you decline, nothing is sent.
authorization.revocable: You can revoke this authorization at any time under Providers.
